protocol.order: All six permutations, then permutations 3 and 4; each arm position count differs by at most one, fixed before results.
protocol.contract: Committed planner and certificate; platform execution sensitivity, not a platform near-optimality guarantee.
protocol.adapter: Same V10 primary-only policy: visible-departure boarding, explicit alighting, physical onboard inertia; no tail rescue.
protocol.release: Root+ceil(measured worker wall), same public pose/prefix/availability revalidation for every arm.
protocol.accounting: Per-arm context/Worker/scan setup plus worker charged; shared graph, fitting and native compilation recorded separately.
protocol.marginal_reference: Same archived incumbent replay without worker; realized difference diagnoses useful publications, not expected optimality.
protocol.sampling: Current shared trip sampler and deterministic floor; fixed 128 worlds.
protocol.alpha: Original per-journey allocation, unchanged across methods.
protocol.scope: All eight existing development roots, once; no new dates or claim of G2 success.
